evidence.title: Charts Blocks for React — Live Previews & Source

name: Charts Blocks
summary: 19 free React chart blocks: pure-SVG market charts, Recharts charts, a histogram and dashboard widgets, with live previews and source.
description: The Spectrum UI chart library as copy-paste blocks: a dependency-free SVG market family (market chart, candlestick, price, indicator with RSI and MACD, depth, order book, portfolio drawdown), area, bar, line, composed, pie, radar and radial charts on Recharts, a latency histogram with percentile pins, and the dashboard set — KPI stat cards, a cohort retention grid and a calendar heatmap.
contains: 19 chart blocks: 7 pure-SVG market charts, 7 Recharts charts, a histogram and 3 dashboard blocks
market family: OHLC candles, volume pane, snapping crosshair, order book ladder, RSI/MACD panes, portfolio drawdown
histogram with percentile pins; KPI stat cards, cohort retention grid and calendar heatmap
live previews with copyable source; free and open source under Apache-2.0
part of Spectrum UI: 111 blocks and 58 components, installable with the shadcn CLI
